name: Atsuma (Japan)
description: A grey field charged at the centre with the Atsuma town emblem in red and yellow: a red disc bearing a stylised character within a yellow wreath of ears of rice.
history: Municipal flag of Atsuma, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 26 March 1968; the emblem dates from 25 December 1954.

features.role: Atsuma town emblem — a red disc bearing a stylised character within a yellow wreath of ears of rice
